Heterotypic tissue regions — two tissue types, two physics

Composing vertex epithelium ⊕ munk mesenchyme (coupled at a reflective interface)

One tissue cross-section, two paradigms: a vertex-simulated epithelium (green sheet, top) sits on a center-based mesenchyme (orange cells, bottom). They are coupled at their interface (dashed line) — the epithelium's basal edge is a floor the mesenchyme presses up against but cannot cross. Each compartment is modelled by the mechanics that fits it.
